description:
Shield Colours

That's it. That's all it does.

Download, source included

Description

Tiny utility mod, lets you configure up to eight colours that you can then apply onto

ships' shields with a hullmod. You may ask: why? During some long battle, I thought:

'Wouldn't it look cool if all my XIV's had a matching orange shield... and the Omens

could be pink to go with their system... and might as well make the close-up ships red

to reflect their aggressive disposition..." and so on.

Spoiler

[close]

How to use

Just set the colours you like using the LunaLib configuration menu; then, to dye a ship's shields,

give it the hullmod corresponding to the desired colour. They are free and always unlocked.

If you don't assign any custom colour, they will have the default aquamarine shields. If the ship

doesn't have shields, or is a phase ship, nothing will happen, obviously.

Questions

What if I'm in the middle of a playthrough?
– This should be okay to add mid-save.What if I have another mod that affects shields?
– I don't know. If the other mod doesn't also manipulate shield colours, they shouldn't have any issues working together.
If it does, one of them will probably overwrite the other.What happens with Fortress Shield?
– Fortress Shield's colour takes priority over the custom one.What happens if I add multiple colour hullmods?
– The highest-numbered one should take priority.Can there be more than eight colour slots?
– Sure, but at some point, I think the clutter in the hullmod selection menu outweighs the benefits.What if I want to modify and/or compile it?
– You will need the Kotlin compiler, but the process is no different than for any other mod.
Link with LunaLib and the game API. There's a licence in the topmost directory.Bugs?
– That's not a question, but probably a few, and please report them.

Dependencies

LunaLib
